title: Projective sheaf models from lisse residue cohomology on a weakly contractible affine
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi$, and residue field $k=R/(\varpi)$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $S$ be an affine weakly contractible scheme for its small pro-etale site [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], meaning that evaluation on $S$ sends every epimorphism of sheaves of sets to a surjection. For each open subscheme $U\subseteq S$, put $B_U=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(R/\varpi^n)_U$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_S))$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume that $K$ is derived complete for its quotient tower, meaning that the quotient maps exhibit $K$ as a derived limit of $(K\otimes^L_{B_S}(R/\varpi^n)_S)_{n\geq1}$, with its canonical reduction transitions and all terms viewed in $D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_S))$ by restriction of scalars [def-weil-derived-limit, def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Assume also that its derived residue reduction $K_1=K\otimes^L_{B_S}k_S$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] has locally constant [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf] constructible cohomology sheaves (locally constant with finite-dimensional $k$-module local models) with only finitely many nonzero degrees [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves], and has finite Tor amplitude locally: there are integers $a\leq b$ such that for every pro-etale $U\to S$ and every $k_U$-module sheaf $L$, the cohomology sheaves of $(K_1|_U)\otimes^L_{k_U}L$ vanish outside $[a,b]$ [def-weil-derived-tensor, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Then there is a finite disjoint open covering $S=\coprod_i U_i$ [def-weil-open-immersion] such that, for each $i$, $K|_{U_i}$ is represented by a bounded complex of $B_{U_i}$-module sheaves whose terms are direct summands of finite sums $B_{U_i}^{\oplus r}$ (each summand has inclusion and retraction maps whose composite is its identity). The differentials are arbitrary $B_{U_i}$-linear sheaf maps; no constancy of their matrix entries over $R$ is asserted.

source.place: Tag 09C3 (lemma-local-structure-constructible-complex): weakly contractible affine, Noetherian coefficient ring, derived completeness, constructible locally constant residue cohomology and locally finite Tor dimension; finite disjoint open cover and completed finite projective module terms. Specialize Λ=R and I=(varpi); restriction of scalars between complete constant and completed coefficients is the equivalence of Tag 099I in algebraization.tex (lemma-restriction-derived-complete-equivalence). Tag 0990 (lemma-proetale-enough-w-contractible) supplies the covering context.

proof.text: By [lem-sf-clopen-lisse-complete-localization], simultaneously trivialize the finitely many nonzero residue cohomology sheaves on a finite clopen partition. On every nonempty piece $U$, restriction preserves completeness and the residue interval $[a,b]$; $U$ is quasi-compact, evaluation is exact, and finite free module sheaves are projective. Work on one such $U$.

source.place: Tag 09C3, lemma-local-structure-constructible-complex, short assembly step 1; extracted arguments in the cited nodes.

proof.text: By [lem-sf-completed-coefficient-free-resolution], shifted finite free $B_U$-sheaves are complete and uniformizer reduction is the stated triangle. Use [det-prop-integral-criterion-constant-coefficients] to identify this completeness with the convention of [det-pe-derived-nakayama-first-reduction]. Thus cones stay complete, and zero residue detects zero complete objects. The coefficient input and completeness convention require no finite-type or characteristic restriction on $U$.

source.place: Tag 09C3, lemma-local-structure-constructible-complex, short assembly step 2; extracted arguments in the cited nodes.

proof.text: Induct on $b-a\geq0$, with claim that any complete $M$ on this fixed $U$ with constant finite-dimensional residue cohomology and residue Tor amplitude $[a,b]$ has a finite free model supported in $[a,b]$. The bound [lem-sf-complete-residue-cohomology-bounds] gives $H^q(M)=0$ outside that interval. Choose residue bases; [lem-sf-projective-cohomology-split-model] supplies their zero-differential model and the shifted-free Hom calculation.

source.place: Tag 09C3, lemma-local-structure-constructible-complex, short assembly step 3; extracted arguments in the cited nodes.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-complete-top-residue-cell-cone] to these bases. It gives $P=B_U^{r_b}$, a map $P[-b]\to M$, and a complete cone $L$ with residue the split complex in $[a,b-1]$. If $a=b$, it gives $L=0$ and $M\cong P[-a]$, proving the base case. If $a<b$, the cone satisfies precisely the induction hypotheses for $[a,b-1]$ on the same $U$, so induction supplies a finite free representative $Q^\bullet$ of $L$ in that interval. This also includes $r_b=0$.

source.place: Tag 09C3, lemma-local-structure-constructible-complex, short assembly step 4; extracted arguments in the cited nodes.

proof.text: Use [lem-sf-projective-top-cell-attachment] for the triangle $P[-b]\to M\to L\to P[-b+1]$ and its representative $Q^\bullet$. Its conclusion realizes the connecting map by an actual sheaf chain map and gives $\operatorname{Cone}(g)[-1]\cong M$ with finite free terms in $[a,b]$. This proves the induction step.

source.place: Tag 09C3, lemma-local-structure-constructible-complex, short assembly step 5; extracted arguments in the cited nodes.

proof.text: Apply the claim to $K|_U$ on every partition member. Finite free terms are direct summands of themselves via identity maps, and the attachment allows arbitrary sheaf-linear differentials. For empty $S$ take the empty partition. On a piece with zero residue, [det-pe-derived-nakayama-first-reduction] gives $K|_U=0$, represented by the zero complex. These choices yield the asserted models.

source.place: Tag 09C3, lemma-local-structure-constructible-complex, short assembly step 6; extracted arguments in the cited nodes.

Steps 2-3 go to the clopen lisse localization node. Step 4 goes to the projective cohomology split model node. Steps 5-6 go to the free-resolution, split-model and top residue cell cone nodes. Free resolution: phi^n is injective on B_T, the two-term complex is a flat bounded complex hence K-flat, and the surjective tower gives R lim = lim, so free cells are complete; the reduction triangle holds for unbounded M. Clopen node: finite affine refinement, section from weak contractibility, clopen preimages, each piece weakly contractible (extend epimorphisms by the terminal sheaf on the complement), Gamma(U,-) exact so C^r is projective, and restriction to the localization commutes with R lim and derived tensor. Split model: lift cycles over U to get a quasi-isomorphism; exact Gamma gives RGamma = Gamma, so Hom(C^r[-q],A) = H^q(A)(U)^r for unbounded A; Tag 064B holds for bounded-above projective sources in any abelian category. Top-cell cone: H^{b+1}(M)=0 by lem-sf-complete-residue-cohomology-bounds (T quasi-compact is a hypothesis), surjectivity onto H^b(M_1), the cone is the split residue plus a contractible identity complex with amplitude [a,b-1], and Nakayama gives L=0 when a=b. Attachment: the only component of g is g^{b-1} with g^{b-1}d=0, Cone(g)[-1] has P in degree b, and rotation gives M ~ fib(delta); checked for b=a+1. Parent hypotheses match each cited statement; edge cases checked: empty S, empty family, r_b=0, a=b. Source labels confirmed: 09C3 at proetale.tex:5825, 09C2, 098F, 0946, 064B, 099I. No SGA is cited. lean.statement: theorem residue_lisse_projective_models (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsAffine S) (hweak : (Scheme.ProEt.topology S).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1} (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 S))) (K : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules.{u, u} l E S)) (hcomplete : IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted l E S K) (hresidue : intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E 1 (by omega) S ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E S 0).obj K)) (hlisse : ∀ q : ℤ, IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf S (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1) ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (proEtaleRingModules S (proEtaleConstantRing S (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1))) q).obj ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E S 0).obj K))) (hTor : HasFiniteProEtaleTorAmplitude S (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1) ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension.{u, u} l E S 0).obj K)) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → S.Opens), (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤ ∧ Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (U i) (U j)) ∧ ∀ i : Fin n, ∃ (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules.{u, u} l E (U i).toScheme) ℤ) (a b : ℤ), a ≤ b ∧ P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧ (∀ r : ℤ, ∃ (N : ℕ) (ι : P.X r ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin N ↦ SheafOfModules.unit (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E (U i).toScheme)) (ρ : (∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin N ↦ SheafOfModules.unit (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E (U i).toScheme)) ⟶ P.X r), ι ≫ ρ = 𝟙 _) ∧ Nonempty ((integralDerivedPullback l E (U i).ι).obj K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
